Package BoundaryClass

package BoundaryClass
Boundary layer containing CLI menu classes responsible for user interaction and driving application flows for distinct roles (Student, CompanyRep, CareerStaff, Login, MainApp).
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CareerStaffCliMenu
    CLI menu for Career Staff users to approve/reject company representatives and internship opportunities, process withdrawal requests, generate reports and configure persistent filters.
    CompanyRepCliMenu
    CLI menu for Company Representative users to create, view, edit, delete and manage internship opportunities as well as review applications.
    DataStore
    DataStore handles the serialization and deserialization of users, internship opportunities, and applications to and from files.
    LoginUI
    LoginUI handles user login and registration interactions via CLI.
    MainApp
    MainApp is the entry point for the Internship Placement Management System CLI application.
    StudentCliMenu
    StudentCliMenu provides a command-line interface for student users to interact with the internship placement management system.
